answer: The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, revoked by a single upheld challenge, duplicates are caught by replay, not by name. Written in a clipped, no filler register, it stays short. A ivory of per-task receipts records who did what, and the ripple of that record is inspected by auditors who gain nothing from passing it. The tundra of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. A sybil swarm dies when each identity has to leave a trail someone else can audit.
